description: This class is a Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for TaxClass entities, providing methods to query tax classes by store, code, and ID in a Java Spring project using QueryDSL.

classes.name: TaxClassDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TaxClassDao for accessing TaxClass entities from the database.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code.

methods.name: getByCode with store
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its ID.
